summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta/full launch and any rights-dependent monetization; CONDITIONAL for ordinary reversible fleet growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only, keep rights outreach unsent pending human counsel and owner authorization, and issue no go-live approval. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution rights; current Woot terms restrict commercial/public listing, price, and derivative use. Accuracy/freshness, security/release, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain blocked. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 8 unknown; 16 sites have banner/consent/GA4 findings and 2 have privacy/terms findings. Analytics is unavailable for 38 expected sites, but incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth. Revenue is limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate Amazon evidence: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 unattributed commission; no ROI, margin, conversion, or causal-lift claim is supported. Next evidence action: complete the existing SearchWoot rights, data-flow, analytics-consent, and vendor/log evidence tasks, then route unresolved rights and jurisdictional questions to human counsel.

Launch-readiness data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked pending current written permission or API agreement expressly allowing storage, historical derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, field use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, and affiliate/advertising use. Smallest next action: attach the authoritative permission record or prepare the owner-approved Woot support request; do not send outreach. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention/deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce one read-only data-flow and retention table from repository/configuration evidence. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal capture, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent/configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident process, and data-subject request procedure. Smallest next action: produce one read-only operator/vendor inventory. No item is closed because direct evidence is absent.

Continue the existing SearchWoot launch-readiness workstream without duplicate tasks. Keep all four launch tasks open: source-rights evidence, alert-data flow/retention, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling. Legal progress: source rights remain blocked; the other three items remain evidence_needed. Next evidence action is a single consolidated read-only evidence bundle covering the four missing evidence sets, with file/config references and timestamps. Do not enable tracking, expand alerts, deploy, change permissions, add dependencies, or send external outreach.

Private or gated site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Evidence: readiness packets are incomplete; complicated.work fails banner/consent/GA4 compliance checks and analytics is unavailable; deadlymaracas.com compliance reachability is unknown; security evidence and operational sweeps are incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one dated readiness packet per site covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker. No publish, DNS change, monetization, telemetry configuration, spending, or queue admission is cleared.
